settings.baseline: saved harmonic boundary_smooth image and float Lab field
settings.boundary: blend toward saved boundary_raw field inside first 8px; no new solve

donor.gate: entire patch inside saved known-paper reference
donor.signal: L minus reference-only Gaussian sigma6; subtract each patch mean; clip to +/-3 L

quilting.first_patch: median patch L residual standard deviation
quilting.cost: overlap mean squared L error plus .02 times reuse count
quilting.seam: row-wise minimum-error vertical and horizontal cuts; joint keep-old union
quilting.comparator: identical selected donor sequence/placements with weighted overlap average

settings.texture_feather: zero at first inside pixel, full at distance>=5px
settings.evaluation: all previous 22 development ROIs; no semantic ROI-label gating
